title: Working with AI
author_or_organization: Nathan Wilmers, Maxim Massenkoff, and Peter McCrory (The Anthropic Institute)
limitations: Qualitative, non-representative opt-in sample of 66 face-to-face video interviews (25–40 minutes) across 58 US Anthropic enterprise customers. Compared with Census BTOS AI adopters, participating firms are larger on average (roughly matching employment-weighted US firm sizes) and skew toward software and finance while underrepresenting retail and transportation. Value ratings, organisational-change scores (r = +0.39 across ~300 applications), software counts (140), and bottleneck frequencies are derived from interviewee self-reports classified by an automated LLM coder rather than audited financials or controlled experiments.
